vo: Payday. One million, seven hundred and thirty thousand kwacha has just landed.
Then rent, fuel and fees start calling. And you wonder, where did it all go?
Rent alone is six hundred and fifty thousand kwacha, before the month has even started.
Ndalama keeps every kwacha in one place. Cash, Airtel Money, Mpamba or bank.
And every morning it tells you what is safe to spend today. Fifteen thousand, seven hundred and three kwacha a day, after bills, debts and savings are set aside.
Your budget is suggested from what you really earn, with a warning if spending runs too fast.
Your goals come with early warnings, so a car or school fees never slip away quietly.
Bills are reminded the day before, and on the day.
Two hundred and thirty-four thousand kwacha is already set aside for your goals, before you spend a kwacha.
At the end of the month, you kept three hundred and seventy thousand kwacha.
Ndalama. Free on APKPure and Uptodown. Google Play and iPhone are coming soon.
